name: gemm_plain

verdict.line: compute-bound: matrix core 65% busy, 1337 TFLOP/s = 54% of the bf16 peak (66% of it at the 1.97 GHz measured); tail: 1.75 rounds of 256 CUs, the last fills 192/256 (12% idle); matrix core idle at barrier 12%; matrix core idle at vmem_issue 8%; L2 re-fetch: 3.4x the call's bytes cross it

roofline.bytes_source: counters: bytes past the L2, read + written

matrix_idle.model: one matrix pipe a SIMD serving its instructions in issue order, each for FLOPs/(the SIMD's peak FLOPs a cycle) cycles; an idle cycle split evenly over the SIMD's waves' current instruction

findings.text: compute-bound: matrix core 65% busy, 1337 TFLOP/s = 54% of the bf16 peak (66% of it at the 1.97 GHz measured)
tail: 448 workgroups = 1.75 rounds of 256 CUs x 1; the last fills 192/256, leaving 12% of the slot-time idle (CUs measured busy 80% of the kernel)
the matrix core idles 12% of the kernel with its waves at barrier (s_barrier: waiting for the workgroup's other waves)
the matrix core idles 8% of the kernel with its waves at vmem_issue (at buffer/global loads and stores: the address/data path is busy)

prologue: the matrix core idles 5% of the kernel while the waves are before the main loop (591 instructions: 311 VALU, 14 loads); at one workgroup a slot no other workgroup's main loop overlaps it, so it adds to the kernel's time

epilogue: the matrix core idles 4% of the kernel while the waves are after the main loop (drain + epilogue) (1055 instructions: 382 VALU, 128 stores); at one workgroup a slot no other workgroup's main loop overlaps it, so it adds to the kernel's time

findings.short: L2 re-fetch: 3.4x the call's bytes cross it
findings.text: the L2 re-fetches: 1032 MB cross it, 3.4x the call's inputs and outputs (63% of the cache-resident rate): tiles shared by workgroups on different XCDs/L2s, or evicted before their reuse

verdict.line: compute-bound: matrix core 65% busy, 1337 TFLOP/s = 54% of the bf16 peak (66% of it at the 1.97 GHz measured); tail: 1.75 rounds of 256 CUs, the last fills 192/256 (12% idle); matrix core idle at barrier 12%; matrix core idle at vmem_issue 8%; L2 re-fetch: 3.4x the call's bytes cross it

cannot: MALL (Infinity Cache) hits: the L2's misses all count as requests to the fabric (TCC_EA0_RDREQ_DRAM = TCC_EA0_RDREQ); a MALL hit and an HBM read look alike, so `dram_bytes` is bytes past the L2

stall reasons by instruction: the counters give the share of wave time waiting for a dependency (s_waitcnt, barrier) or to issue, not which; the thread trace (att) attributes them per instruction on one CU

ceilings.source: MI355X measured (hk.integration.headroom.PEAKS: a register-only v_mfma bf16 loop on every CU, 2.47-2.48 PFLOP/s; a 1 GiB read past the 256 MB Infinity Cache, 6.54-6.60 TB/s); cache-resident 9.1 TB/s (hk.check.CARDS). fp8 is 2x bf16 (datasheet ratio, not measured)

compare.line: bias_gelu takes 1.062x the time of gemm_plain (interleaved in one process: 199.0 vs 187.1 us, band 6%); profiled calls: bias_gelu 192.0 us vs gemm_plain 180.0 us (1.067x the time); matrix core idle after the main loop (drain + epilogue) 4.2% -> 9.9% of the kernel; matrix core busy 65% -> 60%; matrix idle at VALU 2% -> 6%; VALU instructions 1.804e+07 -> 2.222e+07
